The calib fit gave 10.62 (compromise with the constant-accel ramp).

player_ice_drag.note: REAL METERS: rescaled x1.0873 from placeholder meters (python -m measure.rescale). Scale ESTIMATED from the in-game SHOT SPEED readouts of 4 ground goals (median 0.06418 m/px, spread (CV) 2.5%), ASSUMING the mph readout is in real units (measure/results/scale.json). Before: 5.972 placeholder m-units. COMPROMISE (sim model mismatch): the game's coast decays in proportion to speed (rate ~0.85 1/s, 0.52-1.34), the sim's player_ice_drag is a constant deceleration. coasting deceleration with no key held = 101.2 px/s^2 (the sim's model is a constant deceleration). The measured coast is closer to speed-proportional decay (rate 0.52-1.34 1/s, median ~0.85; fits better than a constant in all 11 coasts), so this constant is a compromise; the s6 value (26 m/s^2, stops of 0.07-0.25 s) cannot be coasting, which takes ~3 s here: probably active braking. Held-out by clip (fit on the other two of wkeymovement, diagonalkeypresses, whilemovingturning): 5.928-6.044; calib fitter (Nelder-Mead, time objective) on the runs of all three skating clips, inputs read from the key display (CLAUDE.md 'Session s7'). PLACEHOLDER scale (meters from the painted line spacing, 16.951 px per placeholder m); multiply lengths/speeds/accelerations by the real/placeholder factor (measure/results/scale.json) when the scale is applied.

stick_mass.note: rod pivoting at player center, I = m L^2 / 3

stick_max_ang_speed.note: rotatinganddizzy: hard cap seen as a flat plateau in every cap-limited move (344 frames, median 26.17, sd per frame 1.65 = capture jitter); step model with free onsets, held out by event: RMSE 3.2, 2.3, 1.9, 3.0 deg vs placeholder 8, 363, 251, 151 deg. Scale-free.

stick_max_ang_accel.note: rotatinganddizzy: from the 3 flick starts (rest -> cap within 4 frames). Stops are harder: their fit is flat above ~1500 rad/s^2 (60 fps cannot resolve more), and the real stick overshoots the final angle by 0.7-12.4 deg and settles back, which the sim's symmetric bang-bang braking cannot reproduce. Scale-free.

stick_restitution.note: Holds only for the placeholder stick_mass 2 kg (and puck_mass 0.17 kg): mass and restitution are degenerate in the hit data; refit if stick_mass changes. hittingpuck, 7 hits, calib path objective with stick_mass FIXED at the params.json placeholder 2 kg and puck_mass 0.17 kg (placeholders): stick_mass and restitution are degenerate (a joint fit runs to a rigid stick, e = 0.138); only exit/head speed ~1.1-1.14 is measured. Held out by swing speed: {'slow': 0.36, 'medium': 0.348, 'fast': 0.364}. Changing stick_mass requires refitting this.

stick_z_min.note: stick hits puck only when z is inside [min, max]

max_puck_speed_air.note: horizontal cap for shots that leave the ice

dash_speed.note: REAL METERS: rescaled x1.0873 from placeholder meters (python -m measure.rescale). Scale ESTIMATED from the in-game SHOT SPEED readouts of 4 ground goals (median 0.06418 m/px, spread (CV) 2.5%), ASSUMING the mph readout is in real units (measure/results/scale.json). Before: 9.2454 placeholder m-units. COMPROMISE (sim model mismatch): the game SETS the speed to ~12 m/s (placeholder scale; 11.0-12.5 from rest, 12.2-13.3 from top speed), the sim ADDS an impulse of dash_speed. COMPROMISE for the sim's additive dash impulse = 156.7 px/s, fitted on dashatrest + dashwhilerunning with stage A fixed. The data is a SPEED BOOST to a fixed speed, not an impulse: a dash (Shift with a move key) from rest peaks at 11.0-12.5 m/s within 0.12-0.22 s (10-90% rise 0.07-0.15 s), at top speed it only adds 0.45-3.33 m/s (peak 12.2-13.3). Held-out fails both ways (fit on the other clip: 6.41 / 9.82). Shift with no move key does nothing in the clips (the sim dashes along `facing`).
